research_question.text: 稀疏注意力编码器能否在低资源机器翻译中提升样本效率？
research_question.quote: We study whether a sparse attention encoder improves sample efficiency in low-resource machine translation.

data.text: WMT-14 En-De、IWSLT-14 De-En 与 OPUS-100 三个数据集。
data.quote: WMT-14 En-De, IWSLT-14 De-En and OPUS-100

method.text: 6 层 Transformer，稀疏注意力编码器；批大小 64、学习率 0.001、训练 40 轮；解码器冻结。
method.quote: All models use a batch size of 64 and a learning rate of 0.001 for 40 epochs.

findings.text: 三个数据集上验证误差平均相对降低 18.4%。
findings.quote: the sparse encoder lowers validation error, with a mean relative reduction of 18.4%

findings.text: 仅使用 5% 标注数据时改进仍然存在。
findings.quote: The improvement remains when only 5% of labels are used.

limitations.text: 只评估了翻译任务，结论未必能推广到摘要生成。
limitations.quote: we evaluate only translation tasks, so the result may not transfer to summarisation

section_summaries.text: 提出问题并给出主要数字：18.4% 的验证误差降幅，5% 标注时增益最大。
section_summaries.quote: the encoder reduced validation error by 18.4% relative to a dense baseline

section_summaries.text: 说明低资源场景下稠密注意力易过拟合，由此提出研究问题。
section_summaries.quote: Prior work reports that dense attention overfits when training sets are small.

section_summaries.text: 给出数据集、模型配置与训练超参数，并冻结解码器以隔离变量。
section_summaries.quote: We train a 6-layer transformer with a sparse attention encoder

section_summaries.text: 报告三数据集上的误差下降与标签稀缺下的稳健性，并说明任务范围局限。
section_summaries.quote: On all three datasets, the sparse encoder lowers validation error

knowledge_points.text: 稀疏注意力编码器在低资源机器翻译上把验证误差平均降低 18.4%。
标签稀缺（仅 5%）时增益并未消失。
knowledge_points.quote: The improvement remains when only 5% of labels are used.

knowledge_points.text: 结论仅覆盖翻译任务，不能直接外推到摘要生成。
knowledge_points.quote: the result may not transfer to summarisation
